findings.finding: A registered resale overhang remains sellable inside the window: 10,025,000 PIPE unit shares bought at $1.00 (Oct 2025) and ~5.29M warrant shares exercised at $1.35 in mid-September, registered for resale on 2026-09-16, with the exercised-warrant holders now under water at the $1.31 screen price.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The resale supplement is effective since 2026-09-16 and the shares can be sold on 2026-10-06 with no further filing; holders who paid $1.35 eleven sessions ago are below cost, and the PIPE holders still sit ~31% in profit, so the supply that has met every bounce since 09-16 is not dated as finished.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the 2026-09-16 registration the name has fallen from US$1.85 (09-15 close cited in the supplement) to $1.31; of the post-09-16 comparable falls in the baseline, 09-23 (-2.26), 10-01 (-9.62) and 10-02 (-7.09) continued, 09-15 (+2.70) bounced.
findings.why_not_priced: The fall prices the trial delay; it does not price that the holders of ~15M registered shares (12% of the share count) are still able to sell into tomorrow's tape. If the overhang were spent, a no-news fall on only 2.3x volume would tend to stabilise the next session rather than extend, as own history (50% up) suggests.
findings.independence: Warrant-exercise release confirms 5,287,500 of the 5,712,500 Oct-2025 warrants exercised by 2026-09-15 with acceleration to 2026-10-16: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001702123/000127956926000889/ex991.htm ; short interest +13.2% into 09-15 is consistent with hedged holders (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/CRDL/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). Inference, not a disclosed sale.
